title: centaurea scabiosa var. integrifolia
intro: Centaurea scabiosa var. integrifolia, commonly known as Bluebonnie, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, and its anti-inflammatory properties, which help to soothe digestive issues. The health benefits of Centaurea scabiosa var. integrifolia are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including its ability to act as an antispasmodic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent, which are a result of its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Furthermore, these bioactive constituents are responsible for the plant's ability to exhibit antioxidant, antibacterial, and antifungal properties.
